text: Implemented PreparedStudy and DirectedPairSchedule with immutable bounded candidate/diagnostic pages, explicit source/candidate/selected budgets, overflow-safe planning arithmetic, and source-order duplicate diagnostics shared with legacy pairing. StudyPlan.run and temporal runPrepared consume the same prepared schedules; frames use Agreement and completed score/provenance/reduction semantics are retained. Added 7 independent scheduling tests and 5 prepared-study tests. Affected design/plan/codec/fixation-export/temporal suites passed on JVM and Scala.js (94 executions including the 24 new tests); exact legacy pairing/provenance comparisons and existing rational/Gaussian/temporal oracles pass. checkBoundaries and header/format/generated-workflow checks passed. docs/SAVED_STUDIES.md documents bounds and the remaining whole-operation numeric execution limitation owned by X2-X5. No scientific law suite was introduced. Source changes remain local; proceeding to S1 and M1.
